title: EGO Page Selection Fix
description: Fixes EGO pages being unselectable in touchscreen mode

launcher.label: EGO Page Selection Fix
launcher.note: Fixes EGO pages being unselectable in touchscreen mode.

aeea627ddbd1214764dfef5f965e94a2.reason: LevelUpUI.InitEgo entry: x0 = the LevelUpUI, kept while the EGO page selection is open
LevelUpUI.OnDisable entry: x0 = the LevelUpUI, forgotten
LevelUpUI.OnSelectShow entry (InitEgo calls it): x0 = the LevelUpUI; the card group gets raycasts back as LevelUpUI.Init gives them to the abnormality cards
UICustomSelectable.OnPointerDown entry: x0 = the selectable, x1 = the PointerEventData; a press on an EGO page's selectable is remembered
UICustomSelectable.OnPointerUp entry: x0 = the selectable, x1 = the PointerEventData; a release over the pressed EGO page picks it with LevelUpUI.OnSelectEgoCard
LOR_InputModule.ReleaseMouse entry: x0 = the module, x1 = the PointerEventData, x2 = the object under the pointer; diagnostics log its name and parents while the EGO selection is open
LOR_InputModule.Process entry (x0 = the module), every frame: while the EGO selection is open a finger held on a card opens its description and highlight, as a cursor hovering it would
